_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/icon/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe. Row containers are deliberately not pinned: the leaf rects below already pin the root padding (12), the gaps (12) and every box size, and a container's shrink-to-fit width is not part of what this channel promises.

_derivation.root: column, padding 12, gap 12, alignItems flex-start, size [300,240] -> (0,0,300,240); content starts at (12,12), content width 276.
_derivation.r1: First row at (12,12); row height = the tallest child = 48.
_derivation.sq: size [48,48], first in row 1 -> (12,12,48,48). viewBox 24 => render scale 48/24 = 2, so the local y=12 line is at 12 + 12*2 = 36 and strokeWidth 2 becomes a 4px band, rows 34..37.
_derivation.cu: second in row 1: x = 12 + 48 + 12 = 72 -> (72,12,48,48). The cubic t=0.5 point is ((2+3*2+3*22+22)/8, (2+3*22+3*22+2)/8) = (12,17) local -> (72+24, 12+34) = (96,46), and a 4px band covers rows 44..47. The second sample is the point of MAXIMUM DEVIATION from the best single quadratic through the same ends and the control (3(P1+P2)-(P0+P3))/4 = (12,32): at t=0.789 the cubic is at local (19.704,11.989) and that quadratic is at (17.78,11.989) -- 1.92 viewBox units apart, i.e. 3.85px at scale 2. Pixel (111,35) sits 0.16px from the cubic and 3.2px from the quadratic, so it is solid ink for a real cubic and white for the old approximation.
_derivation.fl: fourth in row 1: x = 132 + 48 + 12 = 192 -> (192,12,48,48). Filled, 2px stroke off. Local (12,16) is inside the triangle (at y=16 the edges are x 5..19) -> (216,44). Local (5,6) is outside (at y=6 the edges are x 10..14) -> (202,24).
_derivation.df: no size given, so the box is the viewBox: 24x24 -> x = 192 + 48 + 12 = 252 -> (252,12,24,24). Render scale 1, so the local y=12 line is at 12+12 = 24 with a 2px band, rows 23..24.
_derivation.st: row 2, first: (12,72,48,48). strokeWidth 6 at scale 2 = 12px centred on local y=12 -> absolute y = 72 + 24 = 96, rows 90..101.
_derivation.vb12: row 2, second: x = 12 + 48 + 12 = 72 -> (72,72,48,48). viewBox 12 => scale 4, so the local y=6 line is at 72 + 24 = 96 and strokeWidth 2 becomes an 8px band, rows 92..99. NOTE (96,92) is the point that separates an 8px band from a 4px one: a 4px band would be rows 94..97, and (96,92) would read white. It is sampled because the glyph is CENTRED, so a wrong scale still lands the path on y=96 -- only the thickness gives it away.
_derivation.ar: row 2, fourth: x = 132 + 48 + 12 = 192 -> (192,72,48,48). Two 180-degree arcs make a circle: local centre (12,12), r=10, viewBox 24 => scale 2, so the absolute centre is (192+24, 72+24) = (216,96) with r=20 and a 4px stroke -> the ring covers radius 18..22. (236,96) is 3 o'clock (radius 20.5), (230,81) is 45 degrees (radius 20.5), (216,96) is the hole (radius 0.7) and (194,74) is outside the ring (radius 30.4). A chord instead of an arc leaves (236,96) and (230,81) white; a wrong centre moves all four.
